title: The Semester of the band room
author: Tamsin Nakamura
blurb: Theo Fairweather, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before the last game of the season.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
